text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Rain, huh... Aw, bummer...
No walkies for today either, I guess...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I've been tired from races lately, so I haven't been able to go for walks...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'm running low on sunlight...
Maybe that's why my body feels so sluggish...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Mmhmmm,
I miss the sunshine so much...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft seems exhausted from her races.
It might be best to adjust her upcoming schedule.
